claims: Lowe's stores are closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
Lowe's closes its stores on Easter Sunday to allow associates to spend the holiday with their families.
All Lowe's locations will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026, during their regular business hours.
Lowe's has a consistent nationwide closure on Easter Sunday.
Home Depot will be open with reduced hours on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
